subject: The journey from kitchen survey to fitting
hook: The model number that can hold up your whole kitchen
ig:
The model number that can hold up your whole kitchen.

It's one of the least exciting decisions in a kitchen project, and one of the most important to get done early.

Integrated appliances, such as a built-in fridge freezer, an oven housing or a dishwasher behind a door, each come with installation dimensions and ventilation requirements from the manufacturer. The cabinet around them is built to suit that specific model.

If you change your mind after manufacture, the replacement might be a few centimetres taller, need a different vent gap or have a door that hinges differently. That's a remake, not a quick swap.

So at design stage we ask for make and model numbers for every built-in appliance, and we design the housings around the installation sheets.

Got your appliances picked yet? Tell us which one you're still undecided on.
fb:
One kitchen tip that saves a lot of headaches: choose your integrated appliances before the kitchen is made.

Built-in fridges, ovens and dishwashers each have their own installation sizes and ventilation needs, and the cabinets around them are built to suit that exact model. Swapping to a different one later can mean an opening that doesn't fit. That's why we ask for make and model numbers at design stage.
